Kate is an independent, open-source project built by one developer who believes everyone deserves a great music player without ads, paywalls, or locked features.

Your donations help support continued development, maintenance, and future improvements. Every contribution, no matter how small, means a lot and helps keep Kate moving forward.

Kate will always remain free. Thank you for being part of this journey. 💜
Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi

Kate is an open-source music player for the songs already on your phone. No accounts, no streaming, no ads. Just your library, with great sound, synced lyrics, and a look you can make completely your own.
